record.question: The refractive index (RI) of a mounting medium should ideally be similar to that of the glass slide and the tissue specimen for optimal clarity. What is the approximate ideal refractive index?
record.explanation: Answer A: 1.4 – 1.54. Mounting media are selected to approximate the refractive index of glass and tissue, typically around 1.52–1.54; the offered interval is broad but is the only option containing this range. Source/context note: Tighten option to approximately 1.52–1.54 rather than 1.4–1.54. Reference: https://www.leicabiosystems.com/knowledge-pathway/histology-fixatives-and-tissue-processing/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
